title: Tencent AI Product Manager Trainee Recruitment Begins, 20+ Exclusive Positions Added
excerpt: On August 13, Tencent launched the recruitment for its "AI Product Manager Trainee" program, fully opening up Tencent's Hunyuan large model, WorkBuddy, and othe
content_html:
On August 13, Tencent launched the recruitment for its "AI Product Manager Trainee" program, fully opening up Tencent's Hunyuan large model, WorkBuddy, and other AI-native products, as well as mature vertical scenarios such as games, social media, finance, and cloud services. More than 20 exclusive positions for trainees have been added for graduates to choose from.

As a specialized recruitment initiative for top AI product talents at Tencent, the "AI Trainee" program will provide highly competitive compensation and core resources for accelerated growth: upon joining, trainees will be assigned to core AI business areas, with a dual mentorship system including cross-team mentors, multi-level exchange platforms such as cross-department AI training courses, and a dual-track development model combining product expertise and AI skills, building a growth path for young people.

Currently, AI has become a long-term strategic focus for Tencent. In 2025, the "Product Manager Trainee" program was upgraded to the "AI Product Manager Trainee," and it has been further upgraded this year. University students graduating between January 1, 2026, and December 31, 2027, can log on to Tencent's official recruitment website join.qq.com, select "Special Talent Programs" - "AI Product Manager Trainee" to apply.

content_html_zh:
8月13日，腾讯启动“AI产品经理培训生”招募，全面开放腾讯混元大模型、WorkBuddy等AI原生产品，以及游戏、社交、金融、云服务等成熟垂直场景。 新增20余个实习生专属岗位供毕业生选择。

作为腾讯专门针对人工智能产品顶尖人才的招聘举措，“AI实习生”计划将提供极具竞争力的薪酬和加速成长的核心资源：实习生加入后将被分配到人工智能核心业务领域，通过跨团队导师的双重导师体系、跨部门人工智能培训课程等多层次交流平台以及产品专业知识和人工智能技能相结合的双轨发展模式，为年轻人构建成长路径。

目前，人工智能已成为腾讯的长期战略重点。 2025年，“产品经理培训生”计划升级为“AI产品经理培训生”，今年又进一步升级。 2026年1月1日至2027年12月31日期间应届毕业生，可登录腾讯官方招聘网站join.qq.com，选择“特殊人才计划”-“AI产品经理实习生”进行报名。
